name: Stationeers
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Build and run a space station, down to its atmosphere and power. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with BepInEx for mods if you want it.
startup: if [ "{{MOD_LOADER}}" = bepinex ]; then if [ -f BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Preloader.dll ]; then export DOORSTOP_ENABLED=1 DOORSTOP_TARGET_ASSEMBLY="$PWD/BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Preloader.dll" LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PWD:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH" LD_PRELOAD=libdoorstop.so; else echo "BepInEx isn't installed, so the server starts without mods. Reinstall the server to install it."; fi; fi; stty cols 80 rows 24 2>/dev/null; rm -f debug.log; (trap '' INT TERM; exec env -u LD_PRELOAD tail -n +1 -F debug.log 2>/dev/null) & ./rocketstation_DedicatedServer.x86_64 -nographics -batchmode -file start "{{SAVE_NAME}}" {{WORLD_NAME}} -logFile ./debug.log -settings ServerName "{{SERVER_NAME}}" StartLocalHost true ServerVisible {{SERVER_VISIBLE}} GamePort {{SERVER_PORT}} UpdatePort {{UPDATE_PORT}} AutoSave {{AUTOSAVE}} SaveInterval {{SAVE_INTERVAL}} ServerMaxPlayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}} UPNPEnabled false ${SERVER_PASSWD:+ServerPassword "$SERVER_PASSWD"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Stationeers. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 600760) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously, and BepInEx when asked. Saves, configs
# and mods are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-600760}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# BepInEx, the mod loader, when asked. Its core files are replaced; its
# config and plugins folders are left alone. Turning it off leaves the
# files but stops loading them.
extra=""
if [ "${MOD_LOADER:-vanilla}" = bepinex ]; then
    repo=BepInEx/BepInEx
    tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" latest 2>/dev/null) || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now to download BepInEx. Reinstall to try again."
    if [ "$(cat BepInEx/.raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
        echo "BepInEx $tag is already installed."
    else
        echo "Downloading BepInEx $tag"
        work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
        rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
        trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
        gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "BepInEx_linux_x64_${tag#v}.zip" "$work/bepinex.zip" || fail "The BepInEx download failed. Reinstall to try again."
        unzip -q "$work/bepinex.zip" -d "$work/b" || fail "The BepInEx download is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
        mkdir -p BepInEx/plugins BepInEx/config
        rm -rf BepInEx/core
        cp -r "$work/b/BepInEx/core" BepInEx/core
        cp -f "$work/b/libdoorstop.so" "$work/b/.doorstop_version" .
        echo "$tag" > BepInEx/.raptor-version
    fi
    extra=" with BepInEx $tag"
fi
echo "Installed Stationeers build ${build:-unknown}${extra}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: World
variables.description: The world a new save starts on, such as Lunar, Mars2, Europa3, MimasHerschel, Vulcan2 or Venus.

variables.name: Save name
variables.description: The save the server loads at start, or creates on World when there's none by that name.

variables.name: Listed
variables.description: true lists the server in the server list; false hides it.

variables.name: Auto save
variables.description: true saves the world every Save interval.

variables.name: Save interval
variables.description: How often the world is saved, in seconds.

variables.name: Mod loader
variables.description: vanilla, or bepinex for mods (put them in BepInEx/plugins). Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Update port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
